about.en: The Silicon Data H100 Rental Index (SDH100RT) is a daily benchmark of the standardized average hourly cost of renting one NVIDIA H100 GPU, quoted in USD per GPU-hour and published by Silicon Data from rental rates observed across cloud and compute providers. Bitget lists a pre-market perpetual on it as H100USDT. It is an index reference, not a token, chip or claim on compute; other GPU price indexes such as Ornn's OCPI H100 are different references.
